hook
Why is one bicycle gear easy uphill, and another one super fast? The secret is gears.
basics
A gear is just a wheel with teeth. When two gears mesh, the teeth push each other around.
dir
Notice something? The second gear spins the opposite way.
dir
Add a third gear, and the direction flips back again.
ratio
Now let's make one gear small, and the other big. The small one has ten teeth. The big one has thirty.
ratio
So the small gear has to spin three times, just to turn the big gear once.
ratio
The big gear turns slower, but with three times more turning force. Scientists call this torque.
ratio
Flip it around, and big to small gives you speed instead. You trade one for the other.
bike
On a bike, a big front gear and a small back gear make the wheel spin fast.
bike
A small front gear and a big back gear make climbing hills easy.
world
Gears are hiding everywhere. In clocks, cars, washing machines, and even your kitchen mixer.
outro
Small teeth, huge wonders. Follow for more science made simple!
